package.title: Bot-wait performance/UX (render economics + answer streaming) and browser offline/online recovery

specification.intent: Close the two tech-debt items recorded in docs/NEXT.md by commit 4edbd99, born from live operation. Item 1 (bot-wait performance/UX): own message takes seconds to appear (feed re-renders per store emit: per-key FLOW_CDU in Block.setProps, registerComponent constructs every Message per render, abandoned withStore hbs-children leak subscriptions that each re-render on every emit), a timeout error pops on a live long POST /bot/runs, and the UI stands on a static placeholder 30-40s because the answer arrives only whole (no streaming; Qwen3.5-9B thinking). Item 2 (browser offline/online): nobody listens to window offline/online; WSTransport exhausts its bounded reconnect budget during long offline and stays dead until F5. Operator constraint 2026-11-04: llama-server inference host is UNAVAILABLE — all streaming evidence is fake-provider/mock based; live smoke (first token < 3s, thinking knob on the real server, offline-during-bot-answer) is DEFERRED acceptance recorded in docs/NEXT.md. Operator decisions: both items, continue on branch feature/2026-11-03-auth-refresh-retry (one PR to dev for the whole contour), full ALK lifecycle. Review-driven decisions (round 1): the pending placeholder gains ONE optional creator-written store field pending_for (the question message id) owned by the same workstream as the bot_delta consumer; the auth warm-up is DROPPED (the global 401→refresh policy already heals a stale access after offline and a race-window reset is a no-op after 30s+ offline — reviews F-1/F-4); stories sockets get the same force-drop as chats (F-7).

requirements.title: Core render economics: one-emit setProps, destroy-replaced-hbs-children with retained exemption, keyed instance reuse
requirements.description: Three GENERIC mechanics in src/core with zero feature knowledge. (1) Block.setProps batches: assign into the RAW props target bypassing the proxy set trap, then emit FLOW_CDU ONCE per call with old/new snapshots (direct this.props.x writes keep the per-key emit; CDM/CDU semantics and ordering unchanged; componentDidUpdate still receives old/new props). (2) Block.compile() destroys replaced _hbsChildren entries ABSENT from the new render's list (by instance reference) — ends the abandoned Messenger/ChatHistory withStore subscription leak (chat.ts:12-16 comment). RETAINED EXEMPTION (review F-2 — mainline, not an edge): a cache-retained instance (mechanic 3) is marked at registration; Block.destroy() and the compile() replacement sweep SKIP retained instances — their lifetime belongs to the feature cache (prune). Without the exemption the leak fix itself would destroy the cached Message instances shared with the new render and gut the feed. (3) registerComponent's helper accepts cacheKey in the hash: on hit it setProps-refreshes the cached instance instead of constructing one (embed MOVES the existing element into the new render); the messenger mapper (mapTypedMessages / withMessenger) supplies cacheKey per message (id:<n> for real messages, the FIXED key pending:tail for the at-most-one pending placeholder per feed — no question-id coupling here, review F-1) and PRUNES the cache to the current feed's keys — entries whose key left the feed are destroyed (chat switch, message removal), no unbounded growth. messenger.hbs passes cacheKey through the existing Message helper call. Residual (review N-2, documented in Risks): each emit still re-renders the feed template O(n); batching + reuse remove the reconstruction cost and the per-key multiplier — the <500ms target is calibrated for current feed sizes and the measured number lands in the progress log. Tests: Block.test.ts (one CDU per multi-key setProps + per-key emit preserved for direct proxy writes; absent-hbs-child destroyed with its store subscription removed; present children survive; RETAINED instances survive BOTH the compile sweep AND a full parent destroy with their element still live in the new parent's DOM), registerComponent-level reuse tests (same instance id across two renders, element moved not re-created; prune destroys dropped keys), messenger.test.ts (mapper emits cacheKeys incl. pending:tail; feed re-render reuses instances), render-count-sensitive suites (chat.test.ts autoscroll) updated inside the write-set — none deleted. Existing suites stay green.
requirements.source: docs/NEXT.md item 1 symptom (a), recon 2026-11-04, review round 1 F-2/N-2

requirements.title: Backend: provider streaming, thinking knob, throttled bot_delta bridge over the chat WS hub
requirements.description: backend/app/bot/provider.py: the BotProvider protocol gains complete_stream(messages) -> Iterator[str]; BOTH concrete providers implement it explicitly (review N-1 — structural implementers do not inherit Protocol defaults): OllamaBotProvider delegates as ONE chunk from complete(), OpenAIChatProvider streams — posts /v1/chat/completions with stream: true, parses SSE lines and yields ONLY choices[0].delta.content (reasoning_content excluded; error kinds provider_timeout/provider_malformed preserved; httpx timeout becomes per-chunk so CHATTY_BOT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS applies between chunks). backend/app/bot/config.py: CHATTY_BOT_ENABLE_THINKING (default true — current behavior; false adds chat_template_kwargs: {'enable_thinking': false} to the request body) and CHATTY_BOT_STREAMING (default true; false bypasses streaming end to end — kill-switch, whole-answer path byte-identical). backend/app/services/bot.py: the execute loop consumes complete_stream, accumulates the full answer (unchanged finalization: message creation, present_one, response_message_id), and forwards coalesced deltas (~250ms window) to an OPTIONAL on_delta(text) callback — never after failure, never blocking/raising into the worker thread. backend/app/api/v1/endpoints/bot.py: builds the bridge (asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe onto the request's event loop; bridge failures swallowed+logged) broadcasting {'type': 'bot_delta', 'content': {'message_id': <question message id>, 'delta': <text>}} via the EXISTING hub.broadcast (membership filter inherited); the final message broadcast, redelivery skip and idempotency stay byte-identical. backend/.env.example: document both new envs AND the forgotten CHATTY_BOT_RAG_MIN_SCORE. docs/deployment/own-backend.md: knobs + recommendation to drop the operator CHATTY_BOT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS 300 → ~60 once streaming is on (code default 60 unchanged). Tests (fakes only, host-independent): SSE parsing (multi-chunk join, reasoning exclusion, malformed/timeout kinds), chat_template_kwargs presence/absence, BOTH providers' complete_stream (explicit ollama single chunk; the protocol default remains for fakes that subclass), CHATTY_BOT_STREAMING=false bypass, service delta coalescing + failure semantics, endpoint bridge bot_delta shape through a fake hub, final-path regression (existing bot suites stay green).

requirements.title: Offline/online watcher, force-reconnect (chats AND stories), intent-differentiated WS-death indicator
requirements.description: NEW src/features/chats/ws/connectivity.ts: idempotent installConnectivityWatchers() binds window offline/online listeners — offline → showBusyOverlay('reconnect'); online → hideBusyOverlay() + reconnectAllChatSockets() + reconnectStoriesSocket() + ChatsController.fetchChats() (reopens every dropped chat with the EXISTING Connected-resync: history before_id null limit 50, dedup append, cursor re-init); navigator.onLine === false at bind time does not fire the online path. NO auth warm-up (review F-4 — dropped: the global 401→refresh policy already heals a stale access after offline; resetting the 2000ms recently-refreshed window is a no-op after 30s+ offline and would REMOVE the anti-kickout guard after a short post-refresh flap; the debt note itself records «протухший access → refresh уже лечится глобально»). WSTransport gains a PUBLIC readonly isOpen probe (additive only — backoff/ceiling/close semantics untouched; the Close event stays payload-free). OwnWsAdapter gains reconnectAll(): close+drop every sockets entry whose transport is NOT open (a stuck-backoff entry becomes re-openable — the sockets.has(id) guard otherwise blocks it); OPEN sockets untouched; gateway exports reconnectAllChatSockets() mirroring closeAllChatSockets. Stories symmetry (review F-7): stories/ws/own.ts gains reconnectStoriesSocket() (close+drop+connect — the existing socket!==null guard silently skips a socket stuck mid-backoff for its whole 5-30s window); gateway re-exports it. INTENT DIFFERENTIATION (review F-3 — WSTransport emits the SAME payload-less Close for manual close() and exhaustion): the ADAPTER tracks intent — closeChat, chat_deleted handling, leaveChat, closeAll and every reconnectAll drop mark the chat id as intentionally closed BEFORE socket.close(); the socket Close handler consults the mark: marked → cleanup only, NO indicator; unmarked Close (reconnect budget exhausted while the transport thought it should be alive) → notify the watcher → indicator shows; a subsequent Connected hides it. Composition root src/features/index.ts binds installConnectivityWatchers() next to the existing seams. Tests: connectivity.test.ts (jsdom dispatches window offline/online; overlay pairs; controller/gateway stubs; double-install idempotent; NEGATIVE — intentional closes produce NO indicator), ws.test.ts (reconnectAll drops non-OPEN and keeps OPEN; intent marks gate the Close notification; Connected hides the indicator), stories own.test.ts (reconnectStoriesSocket force-drops a live-but-backoffing socket), WSTransport.test.ts (isOpen).
requirements.source: docs/NEXT.md item 2, recon 2026-11-04, review round 1 F-3/F-4/F-7

requirements.title: Pending placeholder linkage + WS adapter bot_delta consumption
requirements.description: LINKAGE FIRST (review F-1): the pending placeholder entry in the store messages slice gains ONE optional field pending_for: number — the question message id — written by its ONLY creator (the placeholder append in ChatsController.runBotForLastOwnMessage, controller.ts:530-540) and consumed downstream; this is the single store-shape change of the plan and it lives in the SAME workstream as its consumer, so no wave ever improvises the matching. src/features/chats/ws/own.ts: bot_delta handler in the existing Message dispatch — when the chat has a pending tail whose pending_for EQUALS content.message_id, APPEND the delta text to the placeholder content in ONE store emit (batched by the WS-FE-RENDER-PERF economics); a delta without a matching tail is DROPPED silently (no feed mutation — replayed/foreign deltas and deltas for OTHER members' questions cannot enter the feed; note review N-3: a member's tab that did not ask the question has no tail, sees deltas dropped and receives only the final message — documented limitation); the final answer message replaces the tail through the EXISTING message path (no duplicate text; existing dedup + dropPending + REST fallback untouched). Contract (frozen here, pinned by WS-BE-BOT-STREAM tests): {'type': 'bot_delta', 'content': {'message_id': <question message id>, 'delta': <text>}}. Tests in ws.test.ts: append (one store emit per delta), drop without matching tail (incl. a tail with a DIFFERENT pending_for), final replacement without duplicate.
requirements.source: docs/NEXT.md item 1 symptom (c) frontend side + review round 1 F-1/N-3

specification.goal: Own message appears in <500ms (one store emit = one render per component, unchanged messages reuse instances, no subscription leak growth; measured number recorded); the bot answer streams into the pending placeholder over the existing chat WS (bot_delta matched by the placeholder's pending_for linkage, membership-filtered, kill-switchable, thinking knob documented) with the final message replacing it exactly as today; the browser recovers from offline without F5 (online → overlay hides, stuck chat AND stories sockets force-dropped, all chats reconnected and tail-resynced), with a WS-death indicator that distinguishes intentional closes from exhaustion. All streaming evidence is fake-provider based (host down); live smoke is deferred acceptance.
constraints: Layers only downward; src/core learns three GENERIC mechanics (batched setProps emit, destroy-replaced-hbs-children with the retained exemption, opt-in cacheKey reuse) with zero messenger/bot knowledge; the messenger feature opts in and owns cache pruning; guard-architecture --all --strict stays 0.

Store change is EXACTLY ONE optional creator-written field on the placeholder entry (pending_for?: number); no other store-shape, routing or WS-protocol-breaking changes; the JSON-snapshot compare in Store.set stays.
WSTransport gains ONLY the readonly isOpen probe; the Close event stays payload-free — intent differentiation lives in the adapter (marks set by its own close paths).

bot_delta is a NEW WS event type over the EXISTING hub broadcast (membership filter inherited); the final answer message path (creation, single broadcast on NEW success, redelivery skip, response_message_id, REST fallback, idempotency by message_id) stays byte-identical.

New envs default to current behavior: CHATTY_BOT_ENABLE_THINKING=true, CHATTY_BOT_STREAMING=true; code default CHATTY_BOT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS stays 60 (300→~60 is an operator env recommendation in own-backend.md).
NO auth warm-up on online (review F-4 — dropped; the global 401→refresh policy already covers a stale access; the race-window guard must stay intact).
Deltas without a matching pending tail (pending_for === content.message_id) are dropped on the floor (no feed mutation); no delta handling may create or mutate a real message.
No comments in new/edited scss (stylelint); imports with .ts extension; eslint:fix/stylelint:fix before commit.

Existing suites stay green; mocha counts grow from the 623 base (review F-5); the backend gate is reported in the Windows form (baseline 259 passed + 4 known ingestion failures, 263 collected) with zero NEW failures and all new tests passing — the canonical PYTHON_BIN form stays for Unix/CI.
nonGoals: no Store API change beyond the single pending_for placeholder field (no setMany/coalescing; per-set JSON-snapshot compare stays)
no GET/polling endpoint for bot runs (idempotent POST retry + REST tail fetch already cover lost broadcasts)
no list virtualization/windowing of the feed (residual O(n)-per-emit re-render documented, review N-2)
no streaming for the /assistant REST loop (ai-assistant surface)
no run-scoped placeholders for OTHER members' tabs — only the asking tab streams (review N-3 limitation, follow-up candidate)
no auth warm-up / proactive refresh on online (dropped, review F-4)
no WSTransport backoff/ceiling/payload changes (drop-and-reopen + adapter intent marks instead)

securityGates.statement: bot_delta rides the EXISTING hub.broadcast with its active-membership filter — no new delivery path; pytest pins the fake hub receives the event through the same filtered broadcast used by final messages.

The frontend appends a delta ONLY to a pending tail whose pending_for EQUALS content.message_id; deltas without a matching tail (foreign questions, replays after the final message) are dropped silently and can never create or mutate a real message; mocha pins the drop (incl. a different pending_for) and the no-duplicate replacement.

The WS-death indicator fires ONLY for unmarked exhaustion closes: every intentional close path (closeChat, chat_deleted, leaveChat, closeAll, reconnectAll drops) marks the chat id BEFORE socket.close() and produces NO indicator — negative-pinned by mocha (review F-3); a subsequent Connected always hides the indicator.

Core batching must not change lifecycle semantics: FLOW_CDU still carries old/new props and CDM/CDU ordering is unchanged; the retained-exemption keeps cache-owned instances alive across parent re-renders AND parent destroy; the full existing mocha suite green (no deletions) is the regression gate.
